# Toll

> Toll: exact answers for specific jobs, paid per use from one prepaid balance, on the web, over a REST API or through MCP.

Toll is a Conyso product. Every tool is deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer, with no AI model in the loop. Each content page has a Markdown copy at the same address ending in .md.

## Tools

- [1099 threshold tracker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/): Check which payees need a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC for a payment year, in which box and why: the $2,000 line for 2026 payments, $600 for 2025, royalties at $10 and attorney gross proceeds at $600, with the corporation, card and merchandise exceptions, backup withholding, payees merged by TIN, due dates and an IRIS upload file.
- [Business days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/): Count the business days between two dates, or add business days to a date, for US federal and England and Wales holidays. US holidays are the statutory federal ones only, with no executive-order closures.
- [Delivery date and holiday order-by calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/): Work out when an order arrives, or the last day to order for delivery by a date such as Christmas, from your cutoff time, time zone, shipping days, closures and processing days, on the carrier's own delivery calendar, with USPS's 2026 holiday send-by dates and every skipped holiday named.
- [Exchange rate on a date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/): The official ECB euro reference rate for a currency pair on a date, with the fixing date actually used. When the ECB did not publish on that day, it uses the latest fixing in the 7 days before it and says which.
- [Image to size](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/): Shrink a photo to fit under an exact size in KB, such as 50 KB or 200 KB, for upload forms that set a limit. It runs in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device.
- [Mileage reimbursement and IRS mileage log](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/): Price each trip at the IRS mileage rate in force on its date (2026: 72.5 cents to June 30, 76 cents from July 1; medical, moving, charity and GSA rates too), apply Announcement 2026-11's paid-date rule to employer allowances, total a payroll trip sheet per employee with the true-up owed and the W-2 split above the federal rate, and make an IRS-ready vehicle-year log with a Publication 463 completeness check.
- [Tax set-aside per payment](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tax-set-aside/): How much of one payment a self-employed person should set aside for tax, given what they have earned so far this year: US self-employment tax, federal brackets with the QBI deduction and state income tax, or UK Income Tax, Class 4 and student loan, split exactly where the payment crosses a bracket or threshold, with every constant cited.
- [Trucker per diem worksheet](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/): Turn an owner-operator's days on the road into the year's per diem deduction at the IRS transportation-industry rate in force each day ($80 since October 1, 2024; $69 and $66 before), with departure and return days at 3/4, the 80% hours-of-service limit, log checks and a worksheet for the preparer.

## Guides

- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an LLC? (2026 rules)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/llc/): An LLC gets a 1099-NEC at $2,000 for 2026 services unless it is taxed as a corporation. Single-member, partnership and corporate LLCs worked out, with the exceptions for legal and medical payments.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to a corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/corporation/): Payments to corporations are exempt from 1099 reporting, except legal fees, medical payments, attorney gross proceeds, substitute payments and cash for fish. Worked cases for 2026.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an S corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/s-corp/): An S corporation, or an LLC that elected S corporation tax status, gets no 1099 for most payments in 2026; legal fees and medical payments are the exceptions. Worked cases.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an independent contractor? (2026: $2,000)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/independent-contractor/): A contractor paid $2,000 or more in 2026 gets a Form 1099-NEC; $1,999.99 does not. Card and payment-app payments, payments spread over the year and backup withholding, worked out.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to my property management company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/property-management-company/): Tenants do not send a 1099 for rent paid to a property manager; owners do for management fees of $2,000 or more in 2026 to a non-corporate manager, and managers report rent paid over to owners.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my attorney? (2026: $2,000 fees, $600 settlements)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/attorney/): Attorneys get a 1099 even when incorporated: 1099-NEC for legal fees of $2,000 or more in 2026, 1099-MISC box 10 for gross proceeds such as settlements from $600. Worked cases.
- [Do I have to issue a 1099 to my cleaning lady?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/household-worker/): A 1099 is for business payments, so cleaning your own home needs none; a business that pays a cleaner $2,000 or more in 2026 files Form 1099-NEC. Worked cases.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my landlord? (2026: $2,000 rent)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/landlord/): A business that pays rent of $2,000 or more in 2026 to a non-corporate landlord files Form 1099-MISC, box 1. Rent through a property manager, to a corporation or for your home: no form. Worked cases.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my accountant or CPA?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/accountant-cpa/): Accountants and CPAs get a Form 1099-NEC for $2,000 or more of business fees in 2026, unless the firm is taxed as a corporation. Sole practitioners, partnerships and professional corporations worked out.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my insurance company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/insurance-company/): Premiums paid to an insurance company that is a corporation need no 1099. Commissions of $2,000 or more in 2026 to an unincorporated insurance agent go on Form 1099-NEC. Worked cases.
- [Count business days between two dates in Excel (NETWORKDAYS, with holidays)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-networkdays/): The exact Excel NETWORKDAYS formula for business days between two dates, US federal and England and Wales holiday lists to paste, and why it gives one more than a count that leaves out the start date.
- [Add business days to a date in Excel (WORKDAY, with holidays)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-workday/): The exact Excel WORKDAY formula to add or subtract business days, with US federal and England and Wales holiday lists to paste. WORKDAY and this tool count the same way, so their dates match.
- [Business days in Google Sheets: NETWORKDAYS and WORKDAY with holidays](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/google-sheets-networkdays/): The exact Google Sheets formulas to count business days between two dates (NETWORKDAYS) and add business days to a date (WORKDAY), with US federal and England and Wales holiday lists to paste.
- [Business days API: count and add business days over REST or MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/api/): A REST and MCP API that counts business days between two dates or adds business days to a date, skipping US federal or England and Wales holidays and naming each one. $0.0005 a call.
- [Add business days in Python with holidays (NumPy busday\_offset)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/python/): Add or count business days in Python with NumPy busday\_offset and busday\_count and a US federal holiday list, written to give the same answers as this tool; or call the API from Python.
- [Christmas order deadline banner for Shopify and any store, from your own cutoff](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/christmas-order-deadline-banner/): How to add a Christmas order-by banner to any store, with deadlines from the store's own cutoff and USPS's 2026 send-by dates.
- [Historical exchange rates in Excel by date, from the ECB file](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/historical-exchange-rates-in-excel/): Look up an ECB reference rate for any date in Excel with one XLOOKUP formula, including weekends and pairs without the euro. Worked on the real file: EUR to USD on 31 December 2025 is 1.1750.
- [Which exchange rate to use for US taxes and the FBAR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/which-exchange-rate-for-us-taxes/): The rate each US filing asks for, in the agencies' own words: the spot rate for income and expenses, the IRS yearly averages, and the Treasury 31 December rate for the FBAR.
- [ECB exchange rate API: the official rate for any date over REST and MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-exchange-rate-api/): One POST returns the ECB reference rate for a currency pair on a date, the fixing date actually used and the inverse, for $0.001 a call. The same tool works for AI agents over MCP.
- [KB or KiB: is a kilobyte 1,000 or 1,024 bytes on an upload form?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/kb-or-kib/): Why KB can mean 1,000 or 1,024 bytes, with the byte counts for common upload limits under both readings.
- [IRS mileage log requirements 2026: what each entry needs (Pub 463)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/irs-mileage-log-requirements/): The IRS record elements for a mileage log (Pub 463 Table 5-1), when a log counts as timely, and a checker that lists missing elements.
- [Owner-operator per diem deduction: Schedule C line 24b at 80%](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/owner-operator/): How an owner-operator figures and reports the per diem deduction on Schedule C, with the rest requirement and the 80% limit.
- [Per diem partial days: the 3/4 rule for departure and return days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/partial-days/): How departure and return days are prorated at 3/4 of the transportation-industry rate, with the amount for every notice period.
- [Can company truck drivers claim per diem? (and is employer per diem taxable)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/company-drivers/): Why W-2 truck drivers cannot deduct per diem, and how much employer per diem is tax-free under an accountable plan.

## Overviews

- [Holiday shipping deadlines 2026: USPS send-by dates and your last order date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/holiday-shipping-deadlines-2026/): USPS 2026 Christmas send-by dates and the last order date for a store's own cutoff and processing days.
- [ECB euro reference rates: the latest fixing for every currency](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-reference-rates/): The latest ECB euro reference rate for every currency it publishes, with the change from the fixing before and the weekdays with no fixing.
- [EUR to USD exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/eur-usd/): EUR to USD on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [USD to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/usd-inr/): USD to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [USD to CAD exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/usd-cad/): USD to CAD on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [GBP to EUR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/gbp-eur/): GBP to EUR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.
- [EUR to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/eur-inr/): EUR to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [GBP to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/gbp-inr/): GBP to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [Reduce image size in KB: what each limit from 20 KB to 1 MB does to a photo](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/reduce-image-size-in-kb/): How to reduce a photo to a size in KB, with what limits from 20 KB to 1 MB did to four test photos.

## About

- [Tools](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tools/): Every live tool by category, with what it does and its price per use in words.
- [Pricing](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pricing/): The wallet terms, every live tool's price in words, how a charge is quoted, reserved, settled and refunded, and common questions.
- [How it works](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/how-it-works/): Top up once, use any tool on the web, over REST or over MCP, and pay per use from one balance.
- [Developers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/): The REST API: a quickstart with real requests and responses, API keys, errors, idempotency keys, rate limits, quotes and the OpenAPI document.
- [MCP for AI agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/mcp/): Connect an AI agent over MCP: the server address, authentication, the tools it lists, quote\_price and example calls.
- [Why exact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/why-exact/): Exact answers versus AI guesses, with worked examples from the tools: observed holidays, substitute days, weekend exchange rates and holiday delivery dates.
- [About](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/about/): Who makes the tools and how they work: a small Conyso team, exact tools for specific jobs, no AI in the answers.
- [Docs](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/docs): How to call the tools from code: REST and MCP, authentication, errors, idempotency and limits.
- [Privacy](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/privacy): What Toll stores about visitors and accounts, in plain words.
